title: finding(plugin-dashboard): a stored custom date range cannot be reopened — picking 「Custom…」 again fires no onValueChange, because the select's value already equals CUSTOM_VALUE
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, class (a). `reach:` the UI door, measured. Reader: triage first (route and grade). ⛔ Not graded here.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 4 (`session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY`) from the objectui#10799 dev report (`5859155332`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). The contract review of PR objectui#10838 (`5859296505`, boundary flags) confirmed it at source.

## Measured (the dev's throwaway probe at objectui `33e58d8`, run once, not committed)

`DashboardFilterBar`, with a dashboard `dateRange` filter holding a stored custom range. The probe opened the real Radix select with `user-event` and picked 「Custom…」: the calendar never shows (a `MutationObserver` saw 0 captions at any time). Control: from a preset value, the same click shows the calendar (2 captions).

## Why (read at source)

The select's value is already `CUSTOM_VALUE` when a custom range is stored. `@radix-ui/react-use-controllable-state` 1.2.6 fires `onChange` only when the new value differs from the prop, so `onValueChange` never runs and `setCustomOpen(true)` is never called. An author who set a custom range cannot open it again to edit it. They must pick a preset first and then 「Custom…」, which starts from an empty range.

PR objectui#10838 makes this calendar open on the stored range's month (`defaultMonth`), but that has no visible effect through the UI until this is repaired.

## Direction (for triage to confirm)

Open the custom popover from something that fires on an unchanged value:
- a separate 「Edit range」 trigger shown while a custom range is stored, or
- the `Select`'s `onOpenChange`, or its item's own `onSelect`, for the custom item.

Pin it through the real select: a stored custom range, then 「Custom…」 shows the calendar on the stored `from` month. The preset → 「Custom…」 path is the control.

Also noted by the dev, but NOT measured in a real browser: in happy-dom, 「Custom…」 picked from a preset opens the popover, which is gone within 150 ms, possibly because the select returns focus and that dismisses it. Measure it in the same PR.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed, were listed through REST and grepped locally for `DashboardFilterBar|custom range|Custom…|CUSTOM_VALUE`. The only hits are PR objectui#10838 and PR objectui#10837, objectui#10722 (a date-fns locale card) and objectui#10339 / PR objectui#10346 (a `dateRange` default preset). None covers reopening a stored custom range.

Dedupe words: `dashboard custom range cannot reopen` · `Custom… select same value no-op` · `DashboardFilterBar stored range edit`
